title: Efficient LLM Serving for Agentic Workflows: A Data Systems Perspective (Extended)
authors: Noppanat Wadlom; Junyi Shen; Yao Lu
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving stacks (e.g., vLLM) optimize individual inference calls but treat agentic workflows as a stream of opaque UDFs, losing visibility into inter-operator and inter-workflow prompt and KV-state sharing opportunities. This produces redundant prefill work across operators, passive prefix caching, and operator-level cost myopia that prevents cross-call optimization in batch agentic workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM serving 棧（如 vLLM）著重單一推理 call 的優化，卻將 agentic workflow 視為一連串不透明的 UDF，因而看不到 operator 與 workflow 間 prompt 與 KV state 共享的機會；其結果是跨 operator 重複 prefill、被動式 prefix cache 與 operator 級別的成本盲點，無法在 batch agentic workload 中跨 call 做整體優化。

key_innovation.en: Helium models agentic workflows as DAGs of LLM-as-operators and applies classic query-optimization principles: a Templated Radix Tree (TRT) captures the global prompt-prefix structure and dependencies, a cost-based cache-aware scheduler minimizes total token-step makespan over this TRT, and a proactive KV cache plus prompt cache pre-warms shared prefixes ahead of execution, jointly maximizing intra- and inter-workflow KV reuse.
key_innovation.zh: Helium 將 agentic workflow 視為以 LLM-as-operator 為節點的 DAG，並引入經典 query optimization 原理：以 Templated Radix Tree（TRT）描述全域 prompt prefix 結構與相依關係，由 cost-based、cache-aware 的 scheduler 最小化此 TRT 上的 total token-step makespan；同時以 proactive KV cache 與 prompt cache 預先暖啟共享 prefix，整體最大化 intra- 與 inter-workflow 的 KV 重用。

baselines_compared: vLLM, OpWise, LangGraph, AgentScope, Parrot, KVFlow

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.56x speedup over the strongest baseline (KVFlow) on primitive workflows; up to 1.34x speedup on a multi-stage Trading workflow; up to 100.92x speedup over the unmodified vLLM baseline; scheduling optimality gap of 0.9-3.6% vs an offline MILP optimum.
key_improvements.zh: 於 primitive workflow 上相較最強 baseline KVFlow 最多加速 1.56x；多階段 Trading workflow 加速最多 1.34x；相較未改動的 vLLM baseline 最多加速 100.92x；scheduling optimality gap 相較離線 MILP 最佳解僅 0.9-3.6%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (cost model expressed in token-steps; paper reports optimality gap of 0.9-3.6% vs MILP rather than absolute latency MAPE)
validation_workloads: MMLU, TAT-QA, Amazon Reviews (Map-Reduce / Debate / Reflect / Iterative / Parallel primitive workflows); composite Trading workflow

scope_assumptions.en: Scope restricted to LLM calls plus local data operations (no remote APIs); agents within a workflow share the same base LLM and differ only in prompts; semantic-preserving optimizations only (no proxy models or approximations); cost model based on offline operator profiles with a normalization constant per worker, assuming homogeneous worker hardware; cache scope limited to deterministic operators (greedy or temperature-0 sampling) with LRU eviction.
scope_assumptions.zh: 範圍限定於 LLM call 與本地資料運算（不含遠端 API）；同一 workflow 內 agent 共用相同 base LLM、僅 prompt 不同；只允許 semantic-preserving 優化（不含 proxy model 或近似）；成本模型以離線 operator profile 為基礎並對每個 worker 設定 normalization 常數，假設 worker 硬體同質；cache 範圍限於確定性 operator（greedy 或 temperature-0 取樣）並採 LRU eviction。
